note: Venezuela, read on the Servicio Administrativo de Identificación, Migración y Extranjería's own page on foreigners (saime.gob.ve, 'Extranjería') on 2026-10-30. The page sets out the requirements for renewing the transient visas, each asked online through a SAIME user account with a passport valid six months and the entry and exit stamps: the labour transient visa (TR-L) on a labour authorisation issued by the Ministry of the Popular Power for the Social Process of Work (for work); the rentier's (TR-R) on proof of lawful income or a pension of the equivalent of US$1,200 a month (for means); the Venezuelan family member's (TR-F-V) on proof of the tie to the Venezuelan relative (for family), among others (students, religious, family of a resident). Each is renewable. The page gives no fee, term, time to a decision, first application's place or the work each allows, so none is written; the resident visa and the years to it aren't on this page.

sources.said: REQUISITOS PARA LA RENOVACIÓN DE TRANSEÚNTE LABORAL (TR-L) ... Autorización laboral expedida por el Ministerio del Poder Popular para el Proceso Social de Trabajo. ... REQUISITOS PARA LA RENOVACIÓN DE TRANSEÚNTE RENTISTA (TR-R) ... Certificación de medios lícitos que validen que dicha persona vive de rentas lícitas o pensión con un ingreso mensual equivalente a $1200 al cambio. ... REQUISITOS PARA LA RENOVACIÓN DE TRANSEÚNTE FAMILIAR VENEZOLANO (TR-F-V) ... Documento que demuestre el vínculo fehaciente con el familiar venezolano ... Ingresar a la página web del Saime, crear usuario y contraseña.
